title: MURDLE — The Partner Portal Decoy
subtitle: 5 suspects, 5 tools, 5 locations
storyHtml:
A misleading access alert drew the Dynavics team into a frantic investigation while a partner configuration was changed elsewhere. The evidence identifies one consultant, one tool, and one workspace.

Each consultant had one tool in one location. Follow the Business Central and LS Central trail to isolate the culprit.

clues.text: Dan Jones used the Business Central debugger in the Project Room.
Kieran Coles used the LS Central handheld in the Client Demo Suite.
Rob Jones prepared the API integration brief in the Architecture Studio.
Adam Sellers connected the Production Deployment Laptop through the Partner Portal.
Ian Storer used the Data Migration Toolkit in the Support Hub.
